pr.title: Resurrect repeat-string@1.6.1: replace with String.prototype.repeat
pr.body:
## 🪦 repeat-string@1.6.1 → Replace route

**Why this package:** risk 51/100, status **dormant**.
- No release for 10.1 years
- Imported at 1 site in 1 file

**Coroner's verdict:** A maintained replacement exists: String.prototype.repeat. Repeat strings with the built-in method instead of the unmaintained repeat-string. 2 candidates will be proven against the original before any change is kept.

### What changed
- Added `graveyard/shims/repeat-string.cjs`: String.prototype.repeat with the original type check and empty result for counts below 1
- Rewrote 1 import in 1 file: `src/format.js`
- Removed `repeat-string` from package.json and package-lock.json
- The public API of this project is unchanged: callers keep the same function names and arguments.

### Proof
fast-check generated inputs and ran each one through **both** the original `repeat-string@1.6.1` and the new code. Every output had to be deep-equal (or both had to throw the same error type).

| Property | Runs | Result |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| repeats like repeat-string for any count | 500 | ✅ agree |

500 generated inputs, seed `20261031`, 54 ms. Ran in a Node.js permission-model sandbox: read-only file access, no child processes, empty environment.

#### Attempts
1. ❌ **repeat**: String.prototype.repeat. Rejected after 8 inputs.
   Counterexample `["",-1]`: original returns `""`, candidate returns `throws RangeError`.
2. ✅ **repeat-guarded**: String.prototype.repeat with the original type check and empty result for counts below 1. Agreed on all 500 inputs.

### Replay test (stays in the repo)
40 recorded cases in `graveyard/proofs/repeat-string.golden.json`, replayed by `graveyard/proofs/repeat-string.proof.test.js` with `node --test`: ✅ pass. They keep guarding the behaviour after the original package is gone.

Project tests (`npm test`): ✅ pass

### Risk note
- Equivalence is proven on generated inputs within the documented API, not on every possible value. Repeat strings with the built-in method instead of the unmaintained repeat-string.
- String.prototype.repeat throws on negative counts; the original returns "", so this guards it.

### Provenance
- Original: `repeat-string@1.6.1` (installed copy, matching the lockfile version)
- Integrity: `sha512-PV0dzCYDNfRi1jCDbJzpW7jNNDRuCOG/j…`
- Licence: MIT (no original code is copied)
- Recipe: `repeat-string-native`, candidate `repeat-guarded`

### Reviewer checklist
- [ ] The rewritten imports are the only call sites
- [ ] The risk note matches how this project uses the package
- [ ] CI passes

_Opened by Graveyard Shift. The Coroner chose the route, the Surgeon made the change, the proof decided. A human reviews and merges; nothing is published automatically. After merge, a Warden keeper bot watches this package for new advisories._
